nbac00cc4800.s: Which of the following pairs about Scheduled Castes of Andhra Pradesh (Census 2011) is correctly matched?
nbac00cc4800.x: Andhra Pradesh's 84.69 lakh SCs formed about 4.21% of India's SCs; 17.08% is their share of AP's own population.

n506b46c1802.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the rural distribution of SCs and STs (Census 2011)?
o: STs are more rural than SCs
SCs are more rural than the general population
About 89.97% of STs live in urban areas
SCs form 18.5% of India's rural population
n506b46c1802.x: About 89.97% of STs live in rural, not urban, areas, which makes them even more rural than SCs.

n76f0797fd0d.s: As per the latest official figure, how many notified Scheduled Tribe groups are there in India?
n76f0797fd0d.x: The latest figure is 705 notified ST groups in 30 States/UTs; 698 is an older figure.

nindian-geography-9-1.s: Which of the following tribes practises agriculture along with polyandry?
nindian-geography-9-1.x: The Jaunsari practise agriculture and polyandry; the Raji practised jhum, the Gond hunt and fish, and the Gaddi herd livestock.

nindian-geography-7-2.s: The Jaunsar-Bawar area of Dehradun, Uttarakhand, is the home of which tribe?
nindian-geography-7-2.x: The Jaunsari live in Jaunsar-Bawar of Dehradun, Uttarakhand, not in Himachal Pradesh.

n484c4cecaca.s: Among Mizoram, Tripura, Nagaland and Meghalaya, which State has the lowest Scheduled Tribe share of population?
n484c4cecaca.x: The ascending order is Tripura, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Mizoram; Tripura has the lowest ST share and Mizoram the highest.

n0fc71994f33.s: The Bhils, India's largest Scheduled Tribe, form roughly what share of India's ST population?
n0fc71994f33.x: The Bhils number about 1.7 crore, roughly 16 per cent of India's ST population.

na491e6a8459.s: The Bhutia tribe is mainly found in:
na491e6a8459.x: Bhutias live in Sikkim; Gaddis are of Himachal Pradesh, Santhals mainly of Jharkhand and Jarawas of the Andamans.

n71f865d5a73.s: Of India's 6,40,867 villages in Census 2011, how many were inhabited?
n71f865d5a73.x: India had 6,40,867 villages, of which 5,97,608 (about 93.2%) were inhabited.

n61bdfcb70b4.s: The component of urban growth in which villages are declared towns is called:
n61bdfcb70b4.x: Reclassification turns villages into towns; natural increase and migration are other components, and 'decline in town boundaries' is not a component at all.

new.s: In Census 2011, Scheduled Castes formed what share of India's population?
new.x: SCs numbered 20.14 crore, 16.6% of India in 2011; 16.2% was the 2001 share.

new.s: About what percentage of India's Scheduled Castes lived in rural areas in 2011?
new.x: About 76% of SCs were rural and 24% urban; about 90% (89.97%) is the ST figure.

new.s: Which State had the lowest Scheduled Caste share (about 0.1%) among States with notified SCs in 2011?
new.x: Mizoram's SC share was about 0.1% and Meghalaya's about 0.6%.

new.s: Which of the following north-eastern States has notified Scheduled Castes?
new.x: Manipur has notified SCs; Arunachal Pradesh and Nagaland have no notified SC population.

new.s: Which district had the highest Scheduled Caste share (about 50%) in Census 2011?
new.x: Koch Bihar in West Bengal had the highest SC share among districts, about 50%.

new.s: Scheduled Castes are sparse in which type of districts?
o: Hill, forest and north-eastern tribal districts
new.x: SCs are dense in alluvial plains and deltas, where settled farming used landless labour, and sparse in hill, forest and NE tribal districts.

new.s: In Census 2011, Scheduled Castes formed what share of Andhra Pradesh's population?
new.x: AP's 84.69 lakh SCs were 17.08% of the State's population (APPSC Group 2, 2017).

new.s: The Scheduled Caste population of Andhra Pradesh grew from 32.73 lakh in 1971 to ____ in 2011.
new.x: AP's SCs rose from 32.73 lakh in 1971 to 84.69 lakh in 2011.

new.s: Under which Article does the President notify the Scheduled Castes of each State/UT?
new.x: Article 341 lets the President notify SCs for each State/UT; a State cannot change the list. Article 342 deals with STs.

new.s: How many Lok Sabha seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes after the 2008 delimitation?
new.x: The 2008 delimitation on Census 2001 raised SC seats from 79 to 84 of 543.

new.s: Which Article provides for reservation of seats for SCs in State Legislative Assemblies?
new.x: Article 332 reserves seats in State Assemblies; Article 330 does so in the Lok Sabha.

new.s: Which of the following religious groups is NOT eligible for Scheduled Caste status?
new.x: SC status covers Hindus, Sikhs (added 1956) and Buddhists (added 1990); Jains are not included.

new.s: Article 46, a Directive Principle, directs the State to:
o: Notify Scheduled Castes for each State
Reserve Lok Sabha seats for SCs
Promote the educational and economic interests of weaker sections, especially SCs and STs
new.x: Article 46 asks the State to promote the educational and economic interests of weaker sections, especially SCs and STs.

new.s: The literacy rate of Scheduled Castes in Census 2011 was:
new.x: SC literacy rose from 54.7% in 2001 to 66.1% in 2011, against about 73% nationally.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the socio-economic profile of Scheduled Castes:
1. Most SCs work as marginal farmers and landless labourers.
2. SC unemployment in 2017-18 (5.5%) was lower than the national rate.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: SCs are largely marginal farmers and landless labourers; their 2017-18 unemployment of 5.5% was above the national 5%.

new.s: Which of the following has no notified Scheduled Tribe population?
new.x: Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi and Puducherry have no notified STs; Lakshadweep has the highest ST share.

new.s: Which one of the following groups consists entirely of States/UTs with no notified Scheduled Tribes?
new.x: Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi and Puducherry have no notified STs; Sikkim, Tripura and Lakshadweep have STs.

new.s: Which State had the largest Scheduled Tribe population in Census 2011?
new.x: Madhya Pradesh had the largest ST population (153.17 lakh); Odisha has the most notified tribes (62).

new.s: Which State has the highest tribal density, and which the lowest?
new.x: Tribal density is highest in Bihar (1,106) and lowest in Arunachal Pradesh (17).

new.s: Scheduled Tribes formed what share of India's population in Census 2011?
new.x: STs numbered 10.43 crore, 8.6% of India's population in 2011.

new.s: The pukhor embroidery, which has a GI tag, belongs to the:
new.x: Pukhor embroidery (GI) is of the Todas, the buffalo-herding tribe of the Nilgiris.

new.s: The Changpa nomads, who rear Pashmina goats and yaks, live in:
new.x: The Changpa live in Changthang, Ladakh, rearing Pashmina goats and yaks.

new.s: The Birhor are classified by Vidyarthi and Rai as:
new.x: Vidyarthi and Rai list the Birhor and Chenchu as hunters; Santhal and Munda are agriculturists.

new.s: The largest tribe of Uttarakhand is the:
new.x: The Tharu of the Terai are the largest tribe of Uttarakhand.

new.s: In which year did the Supreme Court's ruling help the Dongaria Kondh stop bauxite mining in Niyamgiri?
new.x: The Dongaria Kondh of Niyamgiri, Odisha, stopped bauxite mining after the Supreme Court ruling of 2013.

new.s: The Chenchu tribe lives in the:
new.x: The Chenchu are a PVTG of the Nallamala forests of Andhra Pradesh.

new.s: The Korku tribe is mainly found in which region?
new.x: The Korku live in Satpura-Melghat; the Baiga in Mandla-Balaghat and the Kadar in the Anamalai.

new.s: The Ghumkaria youth dormitory is associated with the:
new.x: Ghumkaria is the dormitory of the Oraon; the ghotul belongs to the Gonds (Muria).

new.s: Adi Vaani, the AI translation platform, first covers which tribal languages?
new.x: Adi Vaani covers Bhili, Gondi, Mundari and Santali, under the Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan.

new.s: Warang Citi is the script of which tribal language?
new.x: Warang Citi is the Ho script; Santali is written in Ol Chiki.

new.s: Khasi belongs to which language family?
new.x: Khasi is Austro-Asiatic like Santali, Ho and Mundari; Garo and Naga are Tibeto-Chinese.

new.s: Which of the following States has Fifth Schedule Scheduled Areas?
new.x: Telangana is among the 10 Fifth Schedule States; Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram are Sixth Schedule States.

new.s: Which of the following States is NOT required to have a tribal welfare minister under the proviso to Article 164(1)?
new.x: The proviso covers Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, MP and Odisha; Bihar was dropped by the 94th Amendment (2006).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Sixth Schedule:
1. It is provided under Article 244(2).
2. It provides for autonomous district councils.
3. It covers Tripura and Mizoram.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Article 244(2) and the Sixth Schedule set up autonomous district councils in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram.

new.s: The Pahari ethnic group was added to the Scheduled Tribe list of Jammu and Kashmir in:
new.x: The J&K ST Order Amendment Act, 2024 added the Pahari ethnic group, Paddari, Koli and Gadda Brahmin.

new.s: Which of the following was included in the Jammu and Kashmir ST Order of 1991?
new.x: The 1991 order covered Gujjars, Bakarwals, Gaddis and Sippis; the other three were added in 2024.

new.s: The Bhuria Committee of 1994-95 led to:
new.x: The Bhuria Committee (1994-95) on panchayats in Scheduled Areas led to PESA 1996; it differs from the Bhuria Commission (2002-04).

new.s: The Dilip Singh Bhuria Commission (2002-04) was the:
new.x: The Dhebar Commission was the first and the Dilip Singh Bhuria Commission (2002-04) the second Article 339 commission.

new.s: How many Primitive Tribal Groups were first identified in 1975?
new.x: 52 PTGs were identified in 1975; 23 more were added in 1993, making 75.

new.s: Which State has the largest number of PVTGs?
new.x: Odisha has 13 PVTGs, ahead of AP and Telangana together (12) and Bihar with Jharkhand (9).

new.s: Which of the following are among the smallest PVTGs of India?
new.x: The Sentinelese and Great Andamanese are the smallest PVTGs; the Sahariya is the largest.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT among the PVTG variants of Andhra Pradesh added in February 2024?
new.x: AP's three variants added in Feb 2024 were Bondo Porja, Khond Porja and Konda Savara; the Chenchu were already a PVTG.

new.s: To claim rights under the Forest Rights Act, 2006, forest land must have been occupied before:
new.x: The FRA recognises occupation before 13 December 2005, with a 4-hectare ceiling.

new.s: What is the target number of Eklavya Model Residential Schools?
new.x: EMRS, modelled on Navodaya schools, have a target of 740 schools.

new.s: PM-JANMAN was launched on:
new.x: PM-JANMAN was launched on 15 Nov 2023 for 2023-24 to 2025-26, covering 75 PVTGs.

new.s: In how many districts of Andhra Pradesh do the Scheduled Areas lie?
new.x: AP's Scheduled Areas of 16,267.63 sq km (10.15%) lie in 5 districts.

new.s: The Scheduled Tribe share of Andhra Pradesh rose from 5.3% to 5.53% because:
new.x: The older 26.31 lakh (5.3%) figure rose to 27.39 lakh (5.53%) after 7 Polavaram mandals joined AP.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a criterion for a census town?
o: 75% or more of male main workers in non-agricultural work
Density of 400 or more per sq km
A municipality declared by State law
new.x: A municipality by State law makes a statutory town; census towns need 5,000 people, 75% male non-farm workers and 400 per sq km.

new.s: How many statutory towns did India have in Census 2011?
new.x: Of 7,935 towns in 2011, 4,041 were statutory and 3,894 census towns.

new.s: The number of census towns rose from 1,362 in 2001 to 3,894 in 2011, showing the importance of:
new.x: The jump in census towns shows reclassification of settlements as a major component of urban growth.

new.s: India's rural population in Census 2011 was about:
new.x: India's rural population was about 83.3 crore in 2011.

new.s: India's level of urbanisation in Census 2011 was:
new.x: India was 31.16% urban in 2011, up from 27.8% in 2001.

new.s: Which was the most urbanised State in Census 2011?
new.x: Goa was the most urbanised State at about 62.2%.

new.s: Which State had the highest share of rural population (about 90%) in Census 2011?
new.x: Himachal Pradesh was the least urbanised State (~10% urban), so about 90% rural.

new.s: Which Union Territory was the most urbanised in Census 2011?
new.x: Delhi was 97.5% urban, just ahead of Chandigarh at 97.25%.

new.s: The 16th Finance Commission projects India's urbanisation to reach about ____ by 2031.
new.x: The 16th Finance Commission projects 41% urban by 2031; 36% to 45% is the urban bodies' share of local grants.

new.s: Which component explains most of the gap between rural and urban population growth?
new.x: Natural increase is similar in rural and urban areas; rural-to-urban migration explains most of the gap.

new.s: Which of the following is a push factor of urbanisation?
new.x: A failed monsoon leading to rural unemployment pushes people out; the others are pull factors.

new.s: PURA (Providing Urban Amenities to Rural Areas) was the concept of:
new.x: PURA was A.P.J. Abdul Kalam's concept, announced by PM Vajpayee in 2003.

new.s: The Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission was launched in 2016 at:
new.x: The Rurban Mission was launched on 21 Feb 2016 at Kurubhat, Rajnandgaon (Chhattisgarh).

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission:
1. It succeeded PURA.
2. It aims to develop 300 Rurban clusters.
3. It was launched in 2003.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Rurban Mission succeeded PURA and targets 300 clusters; it was launched in 2016, while PURA was announced in 2003.

new.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh had the lowest level of urbanisation in Census 2011?
new.x: Srikakulam was the least urbanised AP district (16.16%); Visakhapatnam was the highest (47.45%).
